research_problem: Proxy/test-based REST specs are incomplete (miss error and configuration-dependent responses); existing generators cannot enumerate all response types per endpoint
technical_approach: RESTpi: path-sensitive, flow-sensitive type inference (path types over syntactic branch conditions) built on Ruby's RDL, with singleton and computed types (Hash#merge, ActiveRecord as_json via DB schema), layered Rails request lifecycle inference, path-type merging and path-insensitive library calls to curb path explosion
primary_contribution: Path-sensitive type inference theory and Ruby implementation enumerating REST response types with their path conditions
dataset_benchmark: 132 control-flow-rich endpoints from 5 Rails apps (Code.org, Discourse, Journey, Canvas, OpenFarm)
evaluation_metrics: Unique response types; median inference time vs control-flow splits (merging on/off); status codes, extra fields and required-field errors vs dynamic proxy specs
baselines: Specifications from test-suite proxying (rswag, rspec-openapi, HAR->OpenAPI)
key_findings: 545 response types (166 x 200, 379 non-200); 1.353 s average per endpoint, 5 timeouts without merging; only 76/132 endpoints exercised by tests; 227 vs 132 response types (+71.97%), non-200 +129.17%; extra fields from serialization formats and access levels; dynamic specs mis-mark required fields
author_limitations: Ruby on Rails specific (DB schema, serialization); no loop typing rules (language-level loops unsoundly analysed once)
analyst_limitations: Precision of extra response types never validated (guards not interpreted, infeasible paths possible); endpoint selection favours the technique; weak baseline (proxy only); response-side only, no request/constraint inference; path conditions not mapped into OpenAPI; small hardware/scale
reproducibility: High: open-source tool and public benchmarks
suggested_extensions: SMT-checked feasibility of path types; path conditions as fuzzing guidance and error-path oracles; access-level-dependent response auditing for data exposure; multi-language/LLM hybrid; conditional-response OpenAPI extension; CI spec checking
evidence_location: Motivation p.2-4; theory p.5-7; implementation p.7-12; setup p.13; RQ1 p.13; RQ2 p.15; RQ3 p.16-17; threats p.17
integrity: Inference-rule symbols partly garbled; tables column-split; runtime figure missing; conclusion section not detected
